paper.title: StreamingBench: Assessing the Gap for MLLMs to Achieve Streaming Video Understanding

evidence.section: Abstract; benchmark construction and task taxonomy
evidence.paraphrase: Nine hundred videos and 4,500 timestamped questions evaluate real-time visual, omni-source, and contextual understanding under causal streaming access.

adjudication_notes: Retained as memory-adjacent because it evaluates streaming-context understanding without isolating a persistent agent-memory mechanism.

2026-09-17 scope review: Sequential Question Answering requires links to entities or events from previous question-answer turns; this is an explicit episodic-history test. Limit the row to SQA; current-frame and generic perception tasks do not establish memory coverage. The legacy scope_status field is not a Table 2 exclusion rule.
